sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Where you find the departed, you'll find the Memorial Mob.
Whether it be along a recent battlefield, an abandoned dungeon...
The Memorial Mob will make an appearance.
If you seek them out, they'll surely present their wares.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Outskirts Wall - Gate Path: found atop the hill next to the broken down building just past General Naomori Kawarada.

sections.heading: Fountainhead Palace (Fountainhead Palace)
sections.text: Upon defeating the Corrupted Monk, the Dragon's Tally Board she drops will unlock new items at every merchant.

sections.heading: Ashina Outskirts ( Outskirts Wall - Stairway )
sections.text: Complete Anayama's questline (see his page for in depth info) to acquire the Promissory Note, which will discount by 10% the cost of every item sold by merchants.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text:
First Encounter with a Mob | Memorial Mob: Care to purchase an offering?
Wolf: An offering?
Memorial Mob: Indeed. I sell items to be offered to the dead, so they might rest in peace. From the looks of you, I'd wager you know a thing or two about death. Go ahead, buy an offering.
First Encounter | Memorial Mob: Care to purchase an offering?
Wolf: Another one.....
Memorial Mob: Where you find the departed, you'll find the Memorial Mob... Just like the crows. ...go ahead, buy an offering.
Leaving | Memorial Mob: Where you find the departed, you'll find the Memorial Mob... Wherever your travels take you, make sure you bring some offerings with you.
Greeting (Generic) | Memorial Mob: Care to purchase an offering?
After Purchasing Robert's Firecrackers | Memorial Mob: Don't use that thing around here, it'll scare the crows. Leaps and bounds smarter than other animals. Cruelty will not be tolerated...
Leaving (Generic) | Memorial Mob: May the departed rest in peace...
When Infected with Dragonrot | Memorial Mob: Memorial offerings and illnesses go hand in hand... Chest, so tight... I must... make an offering...

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Purchasing Robert's Firecrackers is a necessary step to unlock the "All Prosthetic Tools" and "Master of the Prosthetic" trophies.
